messages:
Elena Park: Heads-up: SolarisCloud invoice SC-2026-12-77 for $8,640 arrived but has no PO and was coded to CLOUD-OPS instead of ENG-Platform. PDF: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/2026/solaris-sc-77.pdf :eyes:

invoices-bot: New invoice uploaded: SolarisCloud SC-2026-12-77, amount $8,640, vendor_id=SC-556. No PO detected. Recommended: HOLD. AP ticket AP-9132 created.

Noah Kim: Noted. We had a sandbox soak run for the LLM microbenchmark on Dec 6-7. We expected it to be absorbed by trial credits. Cost center should be ENG-PLATFORM (GL 5602).

Tara Singh: Procurement lookup shows PO-ENG-2026-082 exists for SolarisCloud but it only covers Dec 10-20. This invoice dates are Dec 6-7 so no match. Procurement suggests vendor reissue referencing PO-ENG-2026-082 or issue credit and re-bill. procurement-bot: Potential workaround: `PO-ENG-RETRO-2026-023` if VP approves.

Elena Park: I also noticed approver routing on this invoice went to Sales instead of VP Eng. That needs fixing in vendor master. If AP auto-routes wrong, payment might slip. invoices-bot: Routing detected: approver_group=SalesBilling -> recommended action: hold and re-route to VP Eng.

Noah Kim: Sent vendor a request: "Please reissue invoice referencing PO-ENG-2026-082 or provide a credit memo; correct billing GL to ENG-PLATFORM (GL 5602)." Also asked for meter breakdown. Link to message: internal thread.

Tara Singh: Uploading usage evidence to AP-9132: `s3://redwood-logs/benchmarks/llm/2026-12/12-06-07-usage.csv` 1 shows 1.2TB used vs vendor billed 2.4TB. Attaching to ticket.

invoices-bot: AP-9132 update: vendor_contacted. Vendor responded offering partial credit of $3,200 and to re-bill remainder. They also requested expedited payment if we accept partial credit within 48h, otherwise late fee applies.

Elena Park: Partial credit seems to map to disputed meter lines. Procurement, can you negotiate full correction? If vendor refuses, we'll need VP exception or retro PO.

procurement-bot: Procurement prefers corrected invoice to active PO rather than retro PO. If vendor refuses, procurement requests written approval from VP Eng to create `PO-ENG-RETRO-2026-023`. Note: retro PO requires GL exception and sign-off (Anika).

Noah Kim: If we accept partial credit, we still need documentation showing which runs they admit were double-billed. Ask vendor for a line-item breakdown and raw meter IDs.

Elena Park: Agreed. I'm holding payment and marking invoice as disputed. If vendor doesn't provide a full reissue in 5 business days we'll escalate to Legal. I've CC'd Anika on AP-9132 for faster review.

Anika Rao: Thanks for the flag. I will not approve any payment without either (a) corrected invoice referencing active PO, or (b) documented credit for the full disputed amount, or (c) a formal retro PO request with justification. If procurement asks for retro PO, route to me with usage evidence and a short summary.

Noah Kim: Vendor replied with a CSV of their meter logs: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/2026/solaris-meter-sc-77.csv. It shows two identical job IDs billed twice. I'm attaching to AP-9132.

Tara Singh: Good catch. With that meter evidence we should push for full credit. Procurement, please take the negotiation lead and ask for corrected invoice or full credit.

procurement-bot: Negotiation note added to AP-9132. Suggested negotiation script: "We have evidence of duplicate job IDs on your meter logs. Please issue a full credit or corrected invoice referencing PO-ENG-2026-082 within 3 business days, otherwise we will escalate."

Elena Park: Recording decision path: 1) Await vendor corrected invoice/full credit (3 business days preferred), 2) If partial credit only, escalate to Anika for retro PO or exception, 3) If no response in 5 business days, escalate to Legal. Marking AP-9132 with these SLAs. :white_check_mark:

Noah Kim: I'll monitor AP-9132 and update thread with vendor replies. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
